verdict.rationale: Public status lookup for filings, applications or cases is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The only evidence is two probes that hit HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and nothing beyond those walls was fetched. With no documentation or hands-on evidence of a public status-tracking page, the verdict is none; this reflects missing evidence, not proof the capability is absent.
